acceptance_criteria.criterion: Successful retry after transient error tested

summary: AC1 verified: TestRetryableErrors covers 429, 529, and 500 status codes recovering on second attempt, plus delay and jitter behaviour (5 tests).
AC2 verified: TestFatalErrors confirms 401, 403, and plain ValueError propagate immediately without retry (3 tests).
AC3 verified: TestChunkWriterCleanup confirms partial chunk files are deleted on retry, on exhaustion, and on fatal errors; clean path leaves no deletion (4 tests).
AC4 verified: TestExhaustedRetries confirms last error is re-raised after retries exhausted, and max_retries=0 disables retry entirely (2 tests).
Note: test_nodes_retry.py was not created. The WP-004 Developer placed this coverage in tests/test_stream_retry.py instead; all ACs are satisfied by that file. No duplicate file was warranted.

summary: Reviewed tests/test_stream_retry.py for WP-010 coverage. TestRetryableErrors (5 tests): covers 429/529/500 recovery plus two delay-range property tests that verify the [base*0.5, base*1.0) range per attempt — strong mathematical validation. TestFatalErrors (3 tests): 401/403/ValueError all verified non-retryable with sleep-not-called assertions. TestExhaustedRetries (2 tests): exhaustion path and zero-retries boundary both confirmed.

TestAccumulatorReset (2 tests): partial chunks from failed attempts are not included in the success result — verified with message content inspection. TestChunkWriterCleanup (4 tests): real filesystem operations via tmp_path; glob-asserts that no orphan JSONL files remain after retry, exhaustion, or fatal errors, and that the file is kept on success. All 4 WP-010 ACs met. No blocking issues.

comments.note: Test quality is notably high across all four WP-010 ACs. Two standout patterns worth highlighting: (1) the delay-range property tests (test_sleep_delay_uses_base_delay, test_sleep_delay_doubles_on_second_retry) verify the mathematical formula bounds [base * 0.5, base * 1.0) per attempt rather than just asserting sleep was called — this is the right level of rigour for exponential backoff. (2) TestChunkWriterCleanup uses real filesystem operations via tmp_path and glob-counts JSONL files directly, making these integration-level assertions rather than mock assertions — robust against future refactors of ChunkWriter internals.

[documentation-forward] The module-level docstring of test_stream_retry.py still reads 'Tests the five acceptance criteria for WP-004' but the file now covers WP-009 (TestStageRetryLogEntry) and WP-010 ACs as well. Update the docstring to reflect the broader scope of this test module.
